thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service inference-api -> canary=12 image=redwood/inference:2027-06-01 :rocket:
Olivia: getting alerts, several canary pods entering CrashLoopBackOff right after start
Lee: saw the pager, on it. grabbing pod logs now
Irina: FYI this rollout enabled featureflag `kv-cache-v2` for canary group 12 at 14:02 UTC
Sam: pausing remaining canaries in the job, hold traffic if we can :handshake:
incident-bot: P1 paging Olivia, Lee — Canary crashlooping (container=worker, reason=FailedMount/CrashLoopBackOff)
Olivia: logs show mount error then SIGTERM. snippet:
```
MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "kv-cache" : failed to find persistentvolumeclaim "kv-cache-pvc-canary-12"
E0621 14:03:10.123456 1 kubelet_pods.go:123] Container worker exited with status 137 (OOMKilled)
```
Irina: that PVC name is templated via the chart — I think the values file used `pvcName: kv-cache-pvc` but our canary suffixing expects `-canary-12`. looks like a manifest templating mismatch on the chart override
Lee: also seeing node pressure evictions around the same time on nodes k8s-gpu-12, k8s-gpu-13 — eviction spikes from ephemeral storage exhaustion. nodes show disk.available <10%
Sam: rolling back the deployment to image redwood/inference:2027-05-28 and disabling new canary toggles now
Olivia: executing featureflag kill-switch for `kv-cache-v2` (IRINA please confirm)
Irina: kill-switch ON. disabling feature for all canaries and main traffic. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Reverting to previous replicaSet rs/inference-api-20270528 and scaling canary=0
Lee: after rollback, pod restarts drop from 120/min to ~3/min, eviction rate back to baseline within 2m
James (CS): quick customer impact check — we saw about ~40 unique customer requests return 502/503 during the 14:02-14:05 window in EU region. No long-running outages reported by enterprise customers. Raising a digest to affected accounts.
Olivia: severity assessment: P1 page triggered due to canary health. customer-visible errors limited (<0.1% of traffic), recommend P1->P2 after mitigation confirmed
Sam: filed a quick PR to chart values to fix pvc naming, will open a postmortem ticket with rollback timeline and chart diff. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/1234
Irina: follow-up: need a test that deploys templated PVC names into a real staging cluster before cutover. Also looking into making PVC name optional and fallback to emptyDir for canaries to avoid production PVC churn
Lee: Ops note — nodes k8s-gpu-12/13 need disk cleanup, added ephemeral-cleanup cron to run nightly; also raising node autoscaler thresholds to avoid future eviction spikes
Olivia: handing off to Lee for overnight watch. leaving runbook steps in #oncall-rotation. If anything regresses, page Olivia and Lee
Lee: oncall ack, I have the rollback snapshot, PR id, and customer list. will watch metrics for 2h and then hand back to Irina for remediation work
